title: TASK.md front matter
description: What a task does and where: its order, its complete touch set, the references it cites, and the work a sibling owns. The id comes from the folder name; the title from the H1.

after.description: Tasks that must be trusted before this one starts; children inherit their ancestors' after.

touches.description: The complete touch set: every path the task's commits may change, besides tests. Leaves only.

refs.description: References (SPEC.md refs) this task relies on.

notHere.description: Work that looks like this task's but another task owns.

what.description: The work, as the builder would recognise it.

path.description: A repository-relative path: no leading slash, no `..` segment.

what.description: What changes in the file, in one sentence.
